title: FILTER verse embeddings: isolated and contextual precomputed embeddings
description:
Isolated and contextual embeddings from the selected model. Each Parquet contains 4,275,969 occurrences and 768-dimensional float32 vectors. Join the tables by (p_id, pos, v_id), or use the supplied row-alignment table.
